loose_members.fw: NIST Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework
loose_members.why: GOVERN 1.3 is about setting LEVELS of risk-management activity based on AI risk tolerance, not the management-system clause 6.1 'plan actions to address risks and opportunities'. Related but a different requirement; an ISO 6.1 risk/opportunity register and treatment plan would not by itself satisfy GOVERN 1.3's risk-tolerance-driven activity-level outcome.

offtopic_evidence: AI risk tolerance statement with approval records
AI risk tolerance statement with approval records

loose_members.fw: Qatar Central Bank Technology Risks Circular
loose_members.why: QCB 1.2.4 'Board-approved cyber strategy policy' is an org-level cyber STRATEGY, not a system-level System Security Plan (NIST PL-2) that documents the security controls for a specific system. Different scope and artifact; an SSP would not satisfy a board cyber-strategy requirement and vice versa.

offtopic_evidence: System security plan / cyber strategy policy
Mapping of risks to mitigating measures

loose_members.why: SBP 1.4 'RE Accountability and SBP Oversight Powers' is a regulated-entity accountability / regulator-oversight control for cloud outsourcing, not the third-party CONTINGENCY/exit-plan requirement of NIST GOVERN 6.2. Same evidence (contingency/incident plans) would not satisfy SBP's board-accountability and SBP information-power obligations.
